definitions.explanation: The Chinese dynasty that ruled from 618 to 907, with its capital at Chang'an. Japan sent official missions to it and modeled its laws, capital cities and culture on Tang China.

examples.japanese: {唐|とう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都|みやこ}→都：03747_miyako⟧、{長安|ちょうあん}
examples.english: Chang'an, the capital of Tang China

examples.japanese: ⟦{遣唐使|けんとうし}→遣唐使：16307_kentoushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{唐|とう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}って→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: The envoys to Tang China crossed the sea and studied its culture.

examples.japanese: {奈良時代|ならじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{唐|とう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手本|てほん}→手本：10563_tehon⟧にして⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕組|しく}み→仕組み：07168_shikumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}えた→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: In the Nara period, Japan organized its state on the model of Tang institutions.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The Japanese missions to Tang China (⟦{遣唐使|けんとうし}→遣唐使：16307_kentoushi⟧) ran from 630 to 894 and brought back Buddhism, writing, law and city planning; Nara and Kyoto were laid out on the pattern of Chang'an.

WATCH OUT:
Read から, the same kanji means China or foreign lands in general in older words: ⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧, {唐草|からくさ}. Read とう, it is the dynasty, also in {唐|とう}{代|だい} (the Tang period) and {唐詩|とうし} (Tang poetry).
